source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-46

procedures.title: Plenum (outside air inlet) valve: replace
steps: Remove the vacuum-operated windshield wiper door, the wiper arms, linkage and actuator, and the vent grille (see Section 12).
Remove the clip holding the valve link to the door and push the link up out of the door.
Remove the vacuum valve bracket screws and lift out the valve and bracket together.
Off the car, separate the valve from the bracket if needed.
notes: See figure 57 in the manual (Corvette air inlet valves).
